data_fields.name: service_chance_per_stage
data_fields.donor_constant: 1/20 per service, 1/40 for two rare services (town-encounters.ts:21, 28, 42); stage sum at most 1

data_fields.name: release_wait_with_service
data_fields.donor_constant: 10000 ms with a service, 5000 ms without

data_fields.name: release_wait_per_rank_step
data_fields.donor_constant: 2000 ms per place below the first alive rank

data_fields.name: hub_start_radius
data_fields.donor_constant: 300 x 250 px around the hub centre

best_idea: A town hub that places at most one service per stage from a weighted table, drops a repeat rather than re-rolling it, and releases players on a timer that favours the player who is behind.
decision_why: The per-stage service table and the one-pick rule are zone data that fit our zones-as-data ruling; the no-repeat switch becomes a per-zone choice; the rank-ordered release is a fair pick order for a shared hub; the bot jitter is rejected because bots have no place in a server-verified fight.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a stage offers at most one hub service, that a service chosen earlier in the same run is not offered again when the zone's no-repeat switch is on, and that the player with the higher life total is released after the player with the lower life total.
